name: post.list
description: A brand's posts, each with its stage and its jobs, by day and time.
sql: select brandbase.post_json(to_jsonb(p), coalesce(j.jobs, '[]')) as result from brandbase.posts p left join lateral (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) as jobs from brandbase.post_jobs x where x.post_id = p.id) j on true where p.brand_id = :brand order by p.day, p.time, p.id
